p, k = map(int, input().split())
visited = [False] * p
count_cycles = 0

def explore(start):
    current = start
    while not visited[current]:
        visited[current] = True
        current = (current * k) % p

for i in range(p):
    if not visited[i]:
        count_cycles += 1
        explore(i)

result = 1
for _ in range(1, count_cycles + (1 if k == 1 else 0)):
    result = (result * p) % 1000000007

print(result)
